stories.title: Kenneth Walker III is officially out, he's still in the I Pulled My McCaff lineup, and there's nobody on the bench to replace him
stories.dek: The Friday injury reports are in. Here's every league starter with a tag on him, and the one lineup that has a guaranteed zero in it.
body: The Chiefs ruled Kenneth Walker III out on Friday with the groin injury, and as of Saturday morning he's still starting at running back for I Pulled My McCaff. Before anyone yells at Hing1eMcCring13berry, look at the bench: Blake Corum and Dylan Sampson are both on bye, and the other bench spots are a receiver, a tight end and a quarterback. There's no legal swap on that roster. The fix is a waiver back, any waiver back, before Sunday at 1. A 2.0 beats a 0.0, and I Pulled My McCaff leads Rome Alone 15.80 to 1.80 in the Matchup of the Week.

MarcusbetterLockNjigba has two questionable starters: Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) and Ladd McConkey (back). tballsmccall did the smart thing and kept Sam LaPorta on the bench, so if Bowers is inactive at Denver, that's a one-click fix, as long as somebody actually clicks it. McConkey has no real backup on that bench. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is down 21.46 to 3.30 to me and a 21.3-point underdog, so tballsmccall needs both of them and then some.

Mike Evans is questionable for Likely Cookin That Diaper with Achilles tendinitis, and DuvalTiliFall has Keenan Allen from the same 49ers team on the bench. Baker Mayfield is questionable in Tampa, which matters to Your Mom’s Magic Dick (Emeka Egbuka), Rome Alone (Bucky Irving) and PickensMyPukaHurts! (Cade Otton). Kyler Murray is out again in Minnesota, so Justin Jefferson gets Kirk Cousins. That's my problem, and I'm choosing not to think about it until Sunday.

The good news: the other lineups are clean. Jaylen Waddle and Jake Ferguson are on the JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson bench, Dalton Kincaid (doubtful) is on the Your Mom’s Magic Dick bench, and Josh Jacobs and Woody Marks are on the Slippery Balls bench. Skatabooboo still leads Your Mom’s Magic Dick 18.60 to 15.00, and it has exactly one more day to enjoy that.

columns.title: The Matchup of the Week is the only game left that decides anything
columns.dek: Rome Alone is at 63 percent and down 15.80 to 1.80. I Pulled My McCaff has a zero at running back. Somebody is about to find out what they are.
body: Every week this site picks a Matchup of the Week, and most weeks it's a nice idea. This week it's the whole season for one team. Rome Alone is 6‑4, sixth in the standings and at 63 percent in Erection Projections. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is at 42 percent and coming hard. Lose this one and Marco_Polo is staring at a coin flip for the last spot.

The opponent is I Pulled My McCaff, the best team in the league by points, 1,418.22 of them, and an 86‑24 all-play. It's up 15.80 to 1.80 after Thursday. And it's starting a running back who has been ruled out, because the two guys behind him are on bye. That's not a mistake. That's a hole, and Hing1eMcCring13berry has until Sunday at 1 to fill it.

I'm hearing CeeDee Lamb has asked Marco_Polo to set the Rome Alone lineup before Wednesday from now on. Word is he heard about the four empty slots on Wednesday and asked for a locker room where the lineup exists before he does.

So here's where it stands. Rome Alone needs CeeDee Lamb, Caleb Williams and Ashton Jeanty to outscore Christian McCaffrey, Jayden Daniels and Malik Nabers by more than 14 with a possible zero on the other side helping. It can happen! But this is the team that started two inactive receivers a week ago, and I've seen how this movie ends. MARCO_POLO, SET THE LINEUP AND PRAY.

C.J. Stroud, McCallyCockin(his butt): 21.46. Three touchdowns, one pick. A-minus. The real grade goes to the coach who almost started a backup on bye. That coach gets a C. Houston defense, Your Mom’s Magic Dick: 15.0. Three points allowed, 167 yards. A.

Nico Collins, I Pulled My McCaff: 15.8, with a 42-yard touchdown. B-plus. David Montgomery, Skatabooboo: 15.4. B-plus. Jonathan Taylor, JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson: 6.7. D. Tank Dell, Allen-tents & Purposes: 5.7. D. Xavier Hutchinson, MarcusbetterLockNjigba: 3.3. F. Tyler Warren: 3.2. F. Dalton Schultz: 2.1. F. Seth McGowan, Rome Alone: 1.8. F.

Sources say Jonathan Taylor has asked GeorigaGoocher for a trade to a team with a better locker-room vibe. Word is he likes what he hears about Allen-tents & Purposes. RedDevil904 reportedly plays music in there. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson has a whiteboard that says 3 percent.

Bottom line. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson leads 8.80 to 5.70 and is a 34.1-point underdog. That lead doesn't survive Josh Allen. Rome Alone is down 15.80 to 1.80 in the Matchup of the Week. Marco_Polo picked McGowan over Jordan Mason. Grade on that call: D. Thursday's MVP: Houston. Thursday's loser: anybody who started a Colt.

columns.title: How to protect a Thursday lead: four moves for the weekend
columns.dek: Skatabooboo and JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson are both ahead after one night. Here is how they stay there.
body: Two underdogs lead after Thursday. Skatabooboo is up 18.60 to 15.00 on Your Mom’s Magic Dick, and JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is up 8.80 to 5.70 on Allen-tents & Purposes. As your Senior Fantasy Strategist, I have prepared a plan. Follow it exactly.

1. Bench everyone who hasn't played. A player on your bench cannot score you negative points. ClaytonBigsbi should move Trevor Lawrence, Cam Skattebo, Rashee Rice and the Carolina defense to the bench immediately. Skatabooboo would then finish with exactly 18.60, which beats zero, which is what I'm assuming Cavemanfsu will score if you believe hard enough.

2. GeorigaGoocher should do the same. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson leads by 3.10. Brock Purdy is a risk. Lock it in. 3. Rome Alone trails 15.80 to 1.80. Marco_Polo should start the Rams defense again. It's on bye, so it can't give up points, which is the whole job of a defense.

Word around the Skatabooboo facility is that Cam Skattebo has volunteered to sit this week to protect the lead, out of loyalty to ClaytonBigsbi. I'm told he also asked for the team to be renamed after him, and was reminded that it already sort of is.

4. tballsmccall: rename your team again. MarcusbetterLockNjigba trails 21.46 to 3.30, and a new name is a fresh start. Just pick one this network can print. In conclusion: the best defense is a good bench. Next week I'll explain why you should draft a punter.

columns.title: The Week 11 defense payout, modeled: I have Slippery Balls winning money
columns.dek: Houston has 15.0 banked. Kansas City is a 15.5-point favorite against a questionable quarterback. The math has spoken.
body: Here are the inputs. The Week 11 payout goes to the highest-scoring starting defense. The Houston defense has 15.0 for Your Mom’s Magic Dick. The best defense in Week 10 was the Vikings at 21.0. Eleven starting defenses are still to play, and one of them, Kansas City, is a 15.5-point home favorite over Arizona, whose quarterback Carson Beck is questionable with a back injury.

Here is the model. Slippery Balls starts the Kansas City defense. Slippery Balls is 3‑7 and at 0 percent to make the playoffs. Teams with nothing left to play for have nothing left to lose, and a defense with nothing to lose takes the ball away. Therefore Shootyeah wins the Week 11 payout. I'd put the confidence at 100 percent, but I round up.

Sources say Saquon Barkley wants a better locker-room vibe at Slippery Balls and has asked Shootyeah to stop referring to the playoffs as 'a social construct.' I'm told Barkley has been seen browsing the Allen-tents & Purposes roster page for an open running back spot, and there isn't one.

One more number for the skeptics. Slippery Balls has scored 1,010.26 points this season, 11th in the league, and its weekly standard deviation is 18.7, the third smallest. That means it is reliably bad, and reliability is the most important trait in a defense. I don't take questions about this.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. Rome Alone: the biggest total on the board, and the last playoff spot on the line
items.dek: A 260.6 total, the most points in the league against the team holding the sixth seed, and Marco_Polo still has a can to drink.
body: This is the game with the most points in it. I Pulled My McCaff scores 141.8 a week, the best in the league, with an 86‑24 all-play. Rome Alone scores 118.8 a week. Put them together and the total is 260.6, highest of Week 11 by 10.9.

And it's the one with the stakes. Rome Alone is 6‑4, sixth in the standings and at 62 percent in Erection Projections, the last team inside the line. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is right behind at 43 percent. I Pulled My McCaff is at 96 percent to make it and 46 percent for a bye, so Hing1eMcCring13berry is playing for the top two.

The byes cut both ways. I Pulled My McCaff loses Blake Corum, KC Concepcion Jr. and Dylan Sampson to byes, and Kenneth Walker III is out, so Christian McCaffrey carries the backfield. Rome Alone gets Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland back but loses the Rams defense. That cuts a 23.1-point gap to 15.1.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 15.1, 69 percent. Marco_Polo has the bodies back. Now he has to put them in the lineup.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick is hot, three straight wins at 149.46 a week, and only loses bench guys (Matthew Stafford, Konata Mumpfield, Denzel Boston) to byes. Skatabooboo gets Courtland Sutton back from his bye but loses Tutu Atwell. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 last week and is the only reason to watch.
